purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public land-record routes, bounded anonymous access review, and evidence limits for Jalna.
assessment: Official Maharashtra and Jalna pages establish local land-record custody and a public BhuNaksha route. The indexed viewer shows parcel-number search and map controls, but direct GET retrieval of the viewer and the state service page timed out from this environment. No anonymous ID-plus-geometry response, native field mapping, CRS, or citywide coverage was verified. A timeout is not evidence of citywide absence.
registryAssessment: Jalna local cadastral custody is evidenced by the official Maharashtra contact page naming the District Superintendent of Land Records, Jalna, and subordinate offices. The state services page identifies e-Nakasha/Bhu-Naksha as the map route. Because no actual public parcel geometry response was verified, registryFound remains null and runtime qualification is held.
